description: Validates one exact, platform-authorized Indonesia warehouse-network Dataset Release and publishes bounded source evidence.
responsibilities: Use only exact Dataset Release identities authorized and injected by the platform.
Verify immutable files, customer-assignment alignment, province containment, policy formulas, quote completeness and generator reconciliation through the reviewed Tool.
